headline.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
headline.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, claiming that former Apple employees stole trade secrets to benefit OpenAI's hardware development. The lawsuit also includes IO Products, the hardware startup founded by Jony Ive, as a defendant.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Head of Safety Is Leaving the Company
articles.summary: OpenAI's Head of Safety, Johannes Heidecke, is leaving the company as it seeks to better integrate its research and safety teams. His departure marks a significant change during a period of organizational restructuring within the company.

articles.title: Infinity-Parser2 Technical Report
articles.summary: Infinity-Parser2 is a large multimodal model designed for end-to-end document parsing, utilizing a controllable data-synthesis pipeline and multi-task reinforcement learning to mitigate the lack of annotated parsing corpora. The model features a scalable synthesis engine that combines a controllable rendering framework with an iterative refinement loop, and the authors have made the system open-source.

articles.title: Different Teachers, Different Capabilities: Sub-1B On-Device Distillation for Structured Text Enrichment
articles.summary: The article discusses a method for distilling a large 8 billion parameter model into a smaller 0.6 billion parameter model for structured text extraction, aiming to reduce latency and costs while maintaining comparable output quality. The study evaluates the performance of the distilled model across various sub-tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in generating JSON objects with summaries and categorical labels from news articles.

articles.title: Applying JEPA-Style Predictive Learning to JA4-Derived Network Fingerprints
articles.summary: Researchers have developed JA4-JEPA, a Transformer-based model that applies JEPA-style predictive learning to compact network fingerprints, utilizing data from JA4DB and CIC-IDS-2017. The model is trained on approximately 397,000 samples from various subfields to evaluate the effectiveness of this approach in network analysis.

articles.title: DreamCharacter-1: From 3D Generative Foundation Models to Product-Ready Character Generation
articles.summary: DreamCharacter-1 is a new framework designed to refine pretrained 3D foundation models for high-fidelity character generation in production settings. It features three main components: geometry post-training for improved surface details, texture post-training for high-resolution texture synthesis, and a character rigging module for enhanced animation capabilities.

articles.title: 3100 Opinions on Code Review in an AI World: Building Causal Theory from Practitioner Discourse
articles.summary: The article examines the impact of AI coding agents on the code review process, highlighting divergent opinions among practitioners regarding the necessity of human review and its implications for understanding code. It critiques existing repository-mining studies for lacking depth in explaining the underlying mechanisms of observed trends in code review practices.

articles.title: SpO$_2$ Predictor-Guided Stage-Wise Time-Frequency Reconstruction of Low-Quality Dual-Wavelength PPG for Oxygen Saturation Estimation
articles.summary: The article presents a novel approach for estimating oxygen saturation (SpO$_2$) using low-quality dual-wavelength photoplethysmography (PPG) by employing a predictor-guided stage-wise time-frequency reconstruction method. This technique aims to improve SpO$_2$ prediction accuracy by addressing the limitations of existing denoising and reconstruction methods that often compromise waveform fidelity.

articles.title: PS4: Proxy-Supervised Joint Training for Real Target Speaker Extraction
articles.summary: The article introduces PS4, a proxy-supervised training framework designed for target speaker extraction (TSE) in real conversational mixtures, addressing the challenges posed by the lack of large-scale training data and clean target speech. The framework includes a newly constructed corpus of 71,771 training samples sourced from four public datasets, encompassing both Chinese and English languages.

articles.title: ICDAR 2026 HIPE-OCRepair Competition on LLM-Assisted OCR Post-Correction for Historical Documents
articles.summary: The ICDAR 2026 HIPE-OCRepair Competition focused on utilizing large language models (LLMs) for post-correction of OCR errors in historical documents. The competition highlights the ongoing challenges in digital heritage preservation, particularly in addressing legacy OCR inaccuracies without re-digitizing extensive collections.

articles.title: DrugGen 2: A disease-aware language model for enhancing drug discovery
articles.summary: DrugGen-2 is a new generative model designed to enhance drug discovery by creating small molecules based on both disease context and target protein sequences. This approach aims to improve therapeutic outcomes by integrating disease ontology into the drug design process.

articles.title: Track2Map: Online Deformable SLAM with Motion-Aware Pose Optimization in Robotic Surgery
articles.summary: Track2Map is a novel online 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline designed for robotic surgery, addressing the limitations of existing offline methods that rely on accurate camera trajectory priors. This approach enables real-time deformable 3D anatomy reconstruction by incorporating motion-aware pose optimization, enhancing its applicability in scenarios with noisy or missing data.
